xxw8g20f.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Pre-Lit Snowy Alpine - Warm White Lights
xxw8g20f.sourceDescription: This hugely popular snow-covered Christmas tree range is a real head turner! Our customers love how closely the Pre-lit Snowy Alpine replicates the freshly cut, snowy trees from Christmas films. Combining a flocked and frosted mix of traditional PVC and expertly moulded PE branch tips, you get a realistic Christmas tree that doesn't scrimp on essential snowy features. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 7ft • Pre-Lit with 300 Professionally strung warm white multi function LEDS • Number of branch tips: 829 flocked PE/PVC branch tips • Tree width: 106cm diameter • Foliage colour: Heavily snow flocked dark green • Realistic look: A mix of ultra-realistic plastic moulded tips, with traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Indoor use only: Tree and snow flock must be kept dry • Height measured from the floor • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

r4yyfd29.baseName: My Christmas 4ft Slim Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 120 LED Lights - Green
r4yyfd29.variantName: My Christmas 4ft Slim Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 120 LED Lights - Green
r4yyfd29.sourceDescription: Bring festive style to your home with this slim pencil Christmas tree, designed to provide a traditional Christmas display while taking up minimal floor space. Made with 240 green PVC tips, it creates a full, realistic appearance and is designed for repeated seasonal use. The tree is pre-lit with 120 dual-colour LED lights, offering warm white and cool white illumination to suit different festive styles. With 9 lighting modes, including Combination, In Waves, Sequential, Slo-Glo, Flash, Slow Fade, Twinkle/Flash, Steady On and Off, you can easily customise the display using the included remote control. A sturdy metal stand provides stability, while the simple assembly and disassembly make the tree convenient to store and reuse. Available in 4ft, 5ft, 6ft and 7ft sizes, it is suitable for a variety of festive spaces. Specifications: Made from green PVC with 240 branch tips and 120 warm white and cool white LED lights. Features 9 lighting modes and an included remote control. Supplied with a sturdy metal stand for support. Available in 4ft, 5ft, 6ft and 7ft sizes. Dimensions: Available heights 4ft (122 cm), 5ft (152 cm), 6ft (183 cm) and 7ft (213 cm). Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

Best of all, as they are slimline, they can fit pretty much anywhere, no matter your square footage! Picture shows 6ft tree in the tree.
